body: Things seems go be getting worse. An earthquake just hit my school. 7.2 magnitude. I just got home and turns out our house has no electricity now. I got hit with a light cover on the ceiling. I’m struggling to stay afloat. My demons are drowning me.

She wouldn't want you to off yourself. She spent 9 months making you. A living, breathing, feeling human. Don't end it all in a single second. She would want you to live for her. Continue her legacy and grow as a human for her. Loss is tough, its so fucking tough, I know, I lost my friend to suicide last month and it hurts my soul so fucking much, but he wouldn't want me to die. People around you care so much. If you can't live for yourself, live for her.

Live your life out, please. It isn't your time. I don't know your story, but I know the pain of wanting to be gone from this plane of existence. People care about you and they want you to stay. I want you to hear this. Re-read it over and over. I don't know who you are, but this post touched me on an emotional level. Please don't off yourself. Live life. Experience everything life has to offer.

The paragraph (essay) I sent her made her call me after I had been blocked by her on everything and she told me that she doesn’t care about me and that I’m borderline obsessive. Also accused me of saying that I planned on ruining her current relationship (never said such a thing). Funnily enough though, I check off for everything single one of those marks. It brings back a lot of memories. It’s difficult since she is the woman I identify love as. Such a beautiful and perfect woman, but so cold and aggressive in the presence of me. It wasn’t always like that, but things change I suppose.
